sentences.en: Hello, I'm delighted to welcome you to our Wildlife Club, and very pleased that you're interested in the countryside and the plants and creatures of this area. think you'll be surprised at the variety we have here, even though we're not far from London.
sentences.zh: 你好，很高兴欢迎各位加入我们的野生动物俱乐部，也非常高兴大家对乡村以及本地区的植物和动物感兴趣。我想你们会惊讶于这里的生物多样性，尽管我们离伦敦并不远。

sentences.en: I'll start by telling you about some of the parks and open spaces nearby.
sentences.zh: 我先为大家介绍一下附近的一些公园和开放空间。

sentences.en: One very pleasant place is Halland Common.
sentences.zh: 一个非常宜人的地方是霍兰德荒地（Halland Common）。

sentences.en: This has been public land for hundreds of years, and what you'll find interesting is that the River Ouse, which flows into the sea eighty kilometres away, has its source in the common.
sentences.zh: 这片土地作为公共用地已有数百年历史，而令您感兴趣的是，流入八十公里外大海的乌斯河（River Ouse）正是发源于这片荒地。

sentences.en: There's an information board about the plants and animals you can see here, and by the way, the common is accessible 24 hours a day.
sentences.zh: 这里设有一块信息告示牌，介绍您在此可能见到的动植物；顺便提一下，该荒地全天24小时向公众开放。

sentences.en: Then there's Holt Island, which is noted for its great range of trees.
sentences.zh: 然后是霍尔特岛（Holt Island），它以种类繁多的树木而闻名。

sentences.en: In the past willows were grown here commercially for basket-making, and this ancient craft has recently been reintroduced.
sentences.zh: 过去，这里曾大规模种植柳树用于编制篮子；而这一古老手工艺最近已重新恢复。

sentences.en: The island is only open to the public from Friday to Sunday, because it's quite small, and if there were people around every day, much of the wildlife would keep away.
sentences.zh: 由于岛屿面积较小，若每日开放，大量野生动物将因此避开此处，因此该岛仅在每周五至周日对公众开放。

sentences.en: From there it's just a short walk across the bridge to Longfield Country Park.
sentences.zh: 从那里只需穿过桥走一小段路，即可抵达朗菲尔德乡村公园（Longfield Country Park）。

sentences.en: Longfield has a modern replica of a farm from over two thousand years ago.
sentences.zh: 朗菲尔德公园内建有一座现代化复原的、距今两千多年前的农场。

sentences.en: Children's activities are often arranged there, like bread-making and face-painting.
sentences.zh: 那里常为儿童组织各类活动，例如烘焙面包和面部彩绘。

sentences.en: The park is only open during daylight hours, so bear that in mind if you decide to go there.
sentences.zh: 该公园仅在日间开放，因此若您决定前往，请务必留意这一点。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts J. 54 89 Longfield Park has a programme of activities throughout the year, and to give you sample, this is what's happening in the next few days.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 录音稿 J. 54 89 朗菲尔德公园全年均设有系列活动；为便于您了解，以下为未来几天的具体安排。

sentences.en: On Monday you can learn about herbs, and how they've been used over the centuries.
sentences.zh: 周一，您可以了解各种香草及其数百年来在生活中的应用。

sentences.en: You'll start with a tour of our a herb C.com garden, practise the technique of using them as colour dyes for cloth, and listen to an illustrated talk about their use in cooking and medicine.
sentences.zh: 活动包括：参观我们的香草园、实践用香草为布料染色的技法，以及聆听一场配有图示讲解的讲座，内容涵盖香草在烹饪与医药中的用途。

sentences.en: Then on Wednesday you can join local experts to discover the variety of insects and birds that appear in the evening.
sentences.zh: 随后，周三您可与本地专家一同探索傍晚时分出现的各类昆虫与鸟类。

sentences.en: We keep to a small number of people in the group, so if you want to go you'll need to phone the park ranger a few days ahead.
sentences.zh: 为保障观鸟体验，每组人数严格控制，因此若您有意参加，需提前数日致电公园护林员预约。

sentences.en: There's a small charge, which you should pay when you turn up.
sentences.zh: 活动收取少量费用，您到场时支付即可。

sentences.en: I'm sure you're all keen to help with the practical task of looking after the park, so on Saturday you can join a working party.
sentences.zh: 我相信大家都热切希望参与公园日常维护的实际工作，因此周六可加入志愿劳动小组。

sentences.en: You'll have a choice of all sorts of activities, from planting hedges to picking up litter, so you'll be able to change from one to another when you feel like it.
sentences.zh: 您可自由选择各类活动，例如种植树篱或捡拾垃圾；当您想更换项目时，随时可以调整。

sentences.en: The rangers will be hard at work all day, but do come and join in, even for just a short while.
sentences.zh: 护林员们将全天辛勤工作，但欢迎您哪怕只参与一小段时间，也请积极加入。

sentences.en: One thing, though, is to make sure you're wearing something that you don't mind getting dirty or torn.
sentences.zh: 不过有一点请注意：务必穿着您不介意弄脏或刮破的衣物。

sentences.en: And finally I'd like to tell you about our new wildlife area, Hinchingbrooke Park, which will be opened to the public next month.
sentences.zh: 最后，我想向大家介绍我们的新野生动物保护区——欣钦布鲁克公园（Hinchingbrooke Park），它将于下月正式向公众开放。

sentences.en: This slide doesn't really indicate how big it is, but anyway, you can see the two gates into the park, and the main paths.
sentences.zh: 这张幻灯片其实并未充分展现其实际规模，但您仍可看到公园的两处入口大门及主要步道。

sentences.en: As you can see, there's a lake in the north west of the park, with a bird hide to the west of it, at the end of a path.
sentences.zh: 如您所见，公园西北部设有一座湖泊，湖西侧尽头沿小径建有一处观鸟屋。

sentences.en: So it'll be a nice quiet place for watching the birds on the lake.
sentences.zh: 因此，这将成为一处宁静宜人的观鸟佳地，方便您观赏湖上飞鸟。

sentences.en: Fairly close to where refreshments are available, there's a dog-walking area in the southern part of the park, leading off from the path.
sentences.zh: 在提供餐饮服务地点附近，公园南部设有一处遛狗区，由主步道延伸而出。

sentences.en: And if you just want to sit and relax, you can go to the flower garden: that's the circular area on the map surrounded by paths.
sentences.zh: 若您只想静坐放松，可前往花卉园——即地图上被步道环绕的圆形区域。

sentences.en: And finally, there's a wooded area in the western section of the park, between two paths.
sentences.zh: 最后，公园西部区域、两条步道之间还设有一片林地。

sentences.en: Okay, that's enough from me, SO let's go on to
sentences.zh: 好了，我的介绍就到这里，那么接下来……
